data.standardized_narrative: For the 2018 financial year, Syndicate 4242 experienced a gross prior year strengthening of $28.627 million, representing 23.56% of its opening gross reserves. This adverse development is primarily attributed to natural catastrophe events, specifically Hurricanes Harvey and Irma from 2017, which impacted the 2016 and 2017 years of account. The strengthening is derived from the cumulative gross claims incurred development table, showing increases in estimates for underwriting years 2014, 2015, and 2016.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate has material natural catastrophe exposure and hence the loss ratios particularly reflect the impacts of Hurricanes Harvey and Irma to the 2017 calendar year (impacting the 2016 and 2017 years of account) and Hurricanes Michael and Florence to the 2018 calendar year (impacting the 2017 and 2018 years of account).
